messages:
Alex G: Hi team — new hire here, quick question about Slack norms during my first week. Where should I post setup issues (laptop, VPN), who to ping for access, and any bot commands I should know?
DevEx Bot: Welcome to Redwood! :tada: You're already in #new-hires — good place for intros. For setup: run `@Onboarding Bot checklist` and check pinned Quick Start. For repo access open a ticket in #help or DM a DevEx lead.
Samira: Hey Alex :wave: For hardware/laptop please ping @Ravi in #people-ops or open a ticket in #help with the tag `hardware`. For access requests include your GitHub username and manager's email.
Ravi: Adding: for SSH/GitHub keys do this locally: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@company.com"` then paste `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into the ticket. If you need VPN, tell me your city/timezone and I'll send the invite.
Maya: A couple of quick norms we've found helpful: post company-wide updates in #general (not #random); product/design threads belong in #product; cross-team ops in #eng-infra or #eng-platform. When starting a technical thread, put a one-line summary and expected outcome at the top.
Samira: Bots: use `/standup` in #eng for daily updates, `@onboarding-bot enroll` to join the next orientation cohort, and don't DM deploy-bot for approvals — use the release channel or the deploy UI. Pinning tip: if something matters for the whole team, ask a maintainer to pin it rather than everyone posting it.
Alex G: Cool — for design questions is it OK to post a rough mock in #product or should I DM the PM first?
Maya: Post in #product with the tag `DISCUSS` and mention the PM (or @product-team). If it's sensitive (legal/security), DM first. For quick feedback, a short context + image link works best.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Live intro session this Friday 10:00 PST. Run `@Onboarding Bot checklist` to see outstanding items. Links pinned: https://intranet.company/onboarding/quick-start
Samira: Also set your profile timezone and a short status like `Onboarding — available 9–5 PST` so people know when to DM.
DevEx Bot: Ops cheat-sheet pinned to #new-hires: /onboard, /standup, `@onboarding-bot checklist`, how to join channels (click Join Channel or run the join command listed in pinned docs).
Alex G: Thanks everyone — super helpful. I'll run the checklist and open a ticket in #help if anything breaks.
